name: opencode
one_liner: A free, open-source coding assistant you run yourself instead of paying for a closed commercial one.
buyer: A developer or small dev team that wants an AI coding assistant without vendor lock-in or a per-seat subscription, and is comfortable self-hosting.
business_use_cases: A privacy-conscious dev team self-hosts it instead of paying for a commercial closed-source AI coding tool.
A tool vendor forks it to build and sell a customized, branded coding-agent product for a specific niche (e.g. embedded systems).
An open-source maintainer contributes plugins/extensions and builds a paid support business around them.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a hosted, managed version of it with team features and support for companies that don't want to self-host.
Offer paid custom-integration work connecting it to a company's internal tools and codebases.

steal_this: This weekend, package a managed one-click deploy of it (with a simple admin dashboard) and sell it to small dev teams who want it running without doing the ops work themselves.
